description: This file defines functions, classes, and utilities for efficient string concatenation and appending in C++, including the AlphaNum class for parameter handling, and functions like StrCat and StrAppend. It also includes definitions for formatting types like Hex and Dec, and internal utilities for string conversion.

classes.name: AlphaNum
classes.description: Main parameter type for string concatenation functions, supporting various data types including integers, floats, strings, and user-defined types with custom stringification.

classes.name: Hex
classes.description: Represents hexadecimal formatting parameters for string conversion.

classes.name: Dec
classes.description: Represents decimal formatting parameters for string conversion.

classes.name: AlphaNumBuffer
classes.description: Internal buffer structure for efficient string conversion without memory allocation.

methods.name: StrCat
methods.description: Concatenates multiple strings or values into a single string with no delimiters.

methods.name: StrAppend
methods.description: Appends multiple strings or values to an existing string.
